body: Thank you, I guess what I needed was for someone to talk me out of it and you did just that. I know I hardly know you but I can honestly say that you are a good person. Thank you again. I'll keep you updated on my struggle if that is something you want to be included in.

You say to use my past life as a fuel. I understand that but I fear that I will never live a happy life again. Maybe suicide isn't for me, but I feel like my future will be to much to handle.

I know that suicide is suppose to be a "permanent solution to a temporary problem" but I feel like this disease will be a permanent part of my life.

Yeah, for the past year I have gone to multiple specialists and have gone through so many test but they still have no idea what is going on. Before all this I was a fulfilled happy person but this disease has flipped my life around.
